picks.title: How To Fix Your Life | Khutbah by Dr. Omar Suleiman
picks.summary: What does it take to really fix a broken heart, relationship, and community? Are we making du’a to Allah to fix our lives, while neglecting the actions He wants us to take because they are uncomfortable? It’s easy to skip to the conclusion that your situation isn’t fixable. It’s more difficult, but honest, to remember that nothing fixes itself. Dr. Omar Suleiman explains the power Allah has given us to work to fix our problems, while always trusting Him with the best outcome. And he reminds us of the true cost of leaving our relationships broken. 0:00 - The Strangers: Those who fix what others
picks.reason: A reflective khutbah on personal responsibility and trust in Allah's plan for fixing life.

picks.title: Could Surah Al-Ma'un Be Talking About You? | Surah al-Ma'un | Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi #AMAU
picks.summary: Reflect on Surah Al-Ma'un with Sheikh Mohamed Eid Almuhairi and uncover what it teaches about Salah, the Hereafter and how we treat people. ▶️ Watch more of this series on Tadabbur of the Qur'an: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQM1BksNs60k You may have memorised Surah Al-Ma'un. You may have recited it hundreds of times. But have you ever stopped to ask why Allah places these particular verses together? The Surah begins with the one who denies the Day of Recompense: someone harsh towards the orphan and unconcerned about the poor. Then comes a striking shift: "So woe to those who pray…"
picks.reason: Reflects deeply on Surah Al-Ma'un about ethics, prayer, and the afterlife.

picks.title: The Greatest Opening,What Is Surah Al-Fatihah
picks.summary: Surah Al-Fatihah is the first chapter of the Qur’an, the chapter that appears at the beginning of the Book of Allah and is present in the life of a Muslim every day.It is a surah that a Muslim hears during childhood, memorizes in youth, recites in every obligatory prayer, turns to in times of need, and keeps in the heart long after the Qur’an is closed.Though it contains only seven verses, its meaning reaches deeply into the foundations of Islamic faith.It speaks about Allah, His sovereignty, His mercy, His judgment, worship, dependence upon Him, guidance, righteousness, misguidance, accountab
picks.reason: Explains Surah Al-Fatihah's foundational meaning for Islamic faith and daily life.
